$comment: Master Declarative AI Agent Tool Specifications for FlowX. OpenAI Function-Calling / LangChain StructuredTool / Semantic Kernel compatible schema definitions.

function.name: validate_json
function.description: Validates a candidate FlowX onboarding specification (JSON or YAML) immediately after generation and before downstream execution. Runs OFFLINE -- no SparkSession, no cluster, sub-second -- so it is the mandatory last step of any spec-generation loop: generate, validate, fix from the error text, repeat until valid is true. Performs complete structural validation against control table contracts, allowed-value checks, CDC constraints (e.g. SCD3 transformation-only), restricted SQL grammar validation, secret path checks, governance tag rule verification, AND (v1.7.1) rejection of any attribute the framework does not read -- an unrecognised key is a hard error whose message names the correct attribute, because a silently ignored key onboards and runs while doing nothing. The only check needing a live session is the EXPLAIN-based structural validation of transformation_sql/transform_sql, which is skipped offline (parameter substitution is still checked) and runs at onboarding time on the cluster.

spec_content.description: Full text of the candidate onboarding spec in JSON or YAML format. May contain unresolved {{catalog}} or {{env}} placeholders.

catalog.description: Catalog name substituted for {{catalog}} prior to validation. Defaults to 'poc' if omitted.

env.description: Environment name substituted for {{env}} prior to validation. Defaults to 'dev' if omitted.

strict_mode.description: When true, enforces governance tagging and technical metadata compliance.

valid.description: True if the specification is completely valid with zero errors.

error_count.description: Total number of structural or semantic validation errors discovered.

errors.description: List of individual validation errors formatted as '<json_path>: <message>'.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings (e.g. recommended index optimizations or missing optional tags).

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the validation report.

function.usage_notes: Seed generation from agent_skills/reference/golden_specs.json (five complete, machine-validated specs) rather than composing attributes from memory -- inventing attribute names is the single most common cause of a rejected spec. Keys starting with '_' are always allowed as author comments.

function.name: onboard_entity
function.description: Unified idempotent lifecycle execution tool supporting 'create' and 'update' actions for FlowX pipelines, jobs, and control table entities. Performs preflight validation, upserts control table records (dataflow_group_spec, ingestion_flow_spec, transformation_flow_spec, reconciliation_flow_spec), records audit logs, and optionally triggers initial pipeline graph deployment.

spec_content.description: The validated JSON or YAML onboarding specification text.

action_type.description: Lifecycle action to perform: 'create' for new pipeline onboarding, 'update' to modify an existing active pipeline spec.

auto_deploy.description: When true, automatically starts a Lakeflow pipeline update immediately following successful control table upsert.

dry_run.description: When true, simulates the control table upsert without committing database modifications.

success.description: True if entity onboarding completed successfully.

dataflow_group_id.description: Unique identifier of the onboarded pipeline group.

affected_tables.description: List of control tables updated by the onboarding action.

audit_log_id.description: Unique UUID of the onboarding audit log record.

function.name: get_catalog_schema_parameters
function.description: Retrieval tool to introspect Unity Catalog schemas, Delta table metadata, Volume storage paths, column data types, and applied governance tags. Use this tool before authoring onboarding specs to discover source table schemas, verify existing target tables, or retrieve runtime parameter configurations.

table_name.description: Optional specific table name. If omitted, returns metadata for all tables in the schema.

include_column_metadata.description: When true, returns full column lists with types, nullability, and comments.

include_governance_tags.description: When true, returns all active Unity Catalog table and column tags.

function.name: validate_observability_config
function.description: Lints and validates an {"observability": [...]} fragment against allowed destination types, protocols, auth structures, and compression options.

config_text.description: JSON or YAML string of the observability fragment.

function.name: generate_pipeline_onboarding_config
function.description: Auto-generates an {"observability": [...]} array from destination target parameters (Databricks Volume or OTLP HTTP endpoint) for merging into an onboarding spec.

destination_targets.description: One dict per destination. Required: 'template' ('databricks_volume' or 'otlp_http') plus that template's parameters ('volume_path' / 'endpoint'); both accept an optional 'destination_id'.

mode.description: New in v1.3.0. Selects which observability engine serves this destination: 'triggered' (bounded post-update engine) or 'continuous' (always-on streaming pipeline). Omitting it generates the pre-v1.3.0 shape, which the schema reads as 'triggered'.

event_log_tables.description: New in v1.3.0. REQUIRED when mode is 'continuous': fully-qualified catalog.schema.event_log_table names the streaming pipeline reads. Rejected when mode is 'triggered'.

function.name: diagnose_pipeline_telemetry_failures
function.description: Inspects a failed observability task run's error message and matches it against known failure categories to return diagnostic root causes and concrete remediation steps.
